rule.description: An archive-session owner record graph (the record type together with every record type it embeds by value) is a god owner when its raw inline member fields partition, after discounting fields shared across four or more functions as session backbone, into three or more maximal field clusters whose accessor families are pairwise disjoint: each cluster is one subsystem responsibility the session record absorbed as raw field state instead of leaving behind a dedicated cohesive owner type or per-call state.

checks.description: Detect owner record graphs whose raw inline member fields split into mutually exclusive responsibility clusters: maximal sets of fields that are only ever accessed together by one disjoint family of module functions.
checks.detected_relation: owner record unit -> exclusive co-access cluster of raw inline fields with its own function family
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Every exclusive cluster is a subsystem working-state responsibility (cipher keystream, close-time re-encryption fixup, delete/compaction bookkeeping, entry-name scratch) that the archive-session owner holds inline on its record graph instead of delegating to a dedicated owner type or per-call state; three or more such clusters on one session record is the god-class relation for the C owner-object analog.

matches.evidence: owner record struct zip_t holds 7 raw fields (zip_entry_t.comp, zip_entry_t.header, zip_entry_t.header_offset, zip_entry_t.m_time, zip_entry_t.method, zip_entry_t.state, zip_entry_t.version_made_by) forming an exclusive co-access cluster touched only by 6 functions (_zip_entry_open, zip_entry_close, zip_entry_fwrite, zip_entry_issymlink, zip_entry_openbyindex, zip_entry_write)

owner record struct zip_t holds 4 raw fields (zip_t.deleted_flags, zip_t.len_scratch, zip_t.ofs_order, zip_t.ofs_scratch) forming an exclusive co-access cluster touched only by 4 functions (zip_delete_workspace_reserve, zip_entries_delete_mark, zip_entry_finalize, zip_index_next)

owner record struct zip_t holds 3 raw fields (zip_entry_t.enc_fix_key0, zip_entry_t.enc_fix_key1, zip_entry_t.enc_fix_key2) forming an exclusive co-access cluster touched only by 2 functions (zip_entry_enc_fix_encrypt, zip_entry_enc_fix_password)

owner record struct zip_t holds 3 raw fields (zip_entry_t.enc_orig_key0, zip_entry_t.enc_orig_key1, zip_entry_t.enc_orig_key2) forming an exclusive co-access cluster touched only by 2 functions (zip_entry_enc_orig_decrypt, zip_entry_enc_orig_password)

owner record struct zip_t holds 2 raw fields (zip_t.entry_name_scratch, zip_t.entry_name_scratch_cap) forming an exclusive co-access cluster touched only by 3 functions (zip_entry_name_release, zip_entry_name_set, zip_entry_name_set_normalized)

excluded: struct zip_entry_mark_t (src/zip.c): only the delete walk's element layout; the mark array the session absorbed is counted on the session graph, and the element record itself holds no absorbed responsibility cluster

session-backbone fields such as zip_t.archive, zip_t.level, zip_t.password and the shared entry descriptor fields (index, name, sizes, CRC, external attributes): accessed across four or more function families, so they are discounted as shared backbone rather than exclusive clusters
vendored DEFLATE/ZIP engine records in src/miniz.h (mz_zip_archive, mz_zip_internal_state, tdefl/tinfl state): delegated engine state outside the zip layer's own ownership boundary
error-string tables and stateless path helpers (zip_basename, zip_mkpath, zip_name_normalize): no session-scoped mutable state to absorb
